visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) An adult woman in black pants and a young girl with black hair and bangs sit on a light-colored wooden floor. Between them is a blue and white hexagonal game board featuring a small plastic penguin figure. The adult uses a grey plastic hammer to tap the blocks while the girl watches with a serious, focused expression in a well-lit indoor home setting. (2) The girl takes the plastic hammer in her right hand and begins tapping the white and blue hexagonal blocks. She wears a white dress adorned with strawberry patterns. The camera angle is a low-level medium shot focusing on her face and the game board. Yellow variety captions appear at the bottom of the screen. (3) The girl continues to tap the blocks with increased force. A few blocks fall through the bottom of the tray. She maintains a concentrated gaze, her mouth slightly pursed. The background shows a wooden step and a hint of a bookshelf, suggesting a domestic living room environment. (4) The game board now has several missing pieces. The girl looks at the adult off-camera and then back at the board. The camera zooms in slightly on the penguin figure standing on the remaining ice blocks. The adult's hand enters the frame occasionally to guide the hammer or point at blocks. (5) The girl successfully knocks out a block without the penguin falling. She looks toward the camera with a neutral but attentive expression. Another young child in a blue shirt walks across the background briefly. The lighting remains bright and natural throughout the scene. (6) The penguin eventually falls through the ice. The girl begins picking up the fallen plastic blocks with both hands and attempts to fit them back into the hexagonal frame. She looks slightly tired, rubbing her eyes briefly before looking back at the adult. (7) The girl stares directly into the camera lens with a wide-eyed, calm expression. The adult's hand is visible in the corner of the frame. The video ends with a pink static screen featuring a small cartoon character and English text.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A friendly, animated female voice speaks in Traditional Chinese over a bouncy, upbeat electronic synthesizer background music. The track features a steady 4/4 rhythm. A sharp, high-frequency click sound occurs as a plastic hammer strikes a hard object, followed by the mid-frequency clatter of plastic falling. (2) Multiple loud thuds and clattering sounds indicate several plastic objects falling simultaneously onto a hard wooden floor. The female voice exclaims 'Wow' with a rising, excited pitch contour. The bouncy BGM continues at a consistent volume without interruption or key changes. (3) The female voice continues in a conversational manner, guiding a second, softer child-like voice. Rhythmic, percussive plastic clicking sounds repeat intermittently. The acoustic environment has a subtle room resonance, characteristic of an indoor living space. The background music maintains its cheerful, Major-mode melody. (4) A final sequence of plastic impacts and clatters occurs as the game ends. The female voice transitions to a calmer, lower-arousal tone as she speaks to the child. The BGM remains constant until the very end of the recording where it abruptly stops.
